integrity: All formulas used in the claim are reconstructed from the cited full-text second-variation formulas and exact algebra. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the optimized local second variation for nearby root-lattice Voronoi cells and their volume-preserving affine images, not global minimality for \(D_d\) in dimensions above four.
The condition number describes the quadratic metric Hessian after affine optimization and does not control higher-order nonlinear terms by itself.
title: Complete Hessian-isotropy classification for the root-lattice isoperimetric minima
